name: Local Audio Generation (Procedural)
purpose: Generate a single synthetic audio signal from a compact specification by wrapping ffmpeg lavfi sources. One -Kind per invocation: tone (single sine/square/triangle/sawtooth partial, by frequency or note name), chord (several partials summed), noise (white/pink/brown/blue/violet/velvet, seeded and reproducible), sweep (linear sine chirp), silence. Shaping: duration, sample rate, channels, amplitude, fade in/out. Encodes directly to wav/mp3/flac/opus/ogg/m4a. Deterministic; no model. The cheapest generator: notification beeps, alert tones/chords, reference pitches, masking/focus noise, test signals, and audio fixtures.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -Kind <tone|chord|noise|sweep|silence> (required); tone: -Frequency <hz> | -Note <A4|C#3|Bb5>, -Waveform <sine|square|triangle|sawtooth>; chord: -Frequencies '440,554.37,659.25' | -Notes 'C4,E4,G4', -Waveform; noise: -Color <white|pink|brown|blue|violet|velvet>, -Seed <int>; sweep: -FreqStart <hz> -FreqEnd <hz>; shaping (all): -Duration <s> -SampleRate <hz> -Channels <1|2> -Amplitude <0..1> -FadeInMs <n> -FadeOutMs <n>; output: -Format <wav|mp3|flac|opus|ogg|m4a> -SampleFormat <s16|s24|s32|flt> -Bitrate <e.g. 192k>; -FfmpegPath/-FfprobePath <override>. OR -InputsJson '<json {kind,frequency,note,frequencies,notes,waveform,color,freq_start,freq_end,seed,duration,sample_rate,channels,amplitude,fade_in_ms,fade_out_ms,format,sample_fmt,bitrate,ffmpeg_path,ffprobe_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: Generator: tone | chord | noise | sweep | silence.

inputs.name: frequency
inputs.description: Tone frequency in Hz (used when -Note is not given).

inputs.name: note
inputs.description: Tone pitch by equal-temperament name (A4=440), e.g. A4, C#3, Bb5. Overrides frequency.

inputs.name: frequencies
inputs.description: Chord partials as a comma-separated Hz list, e.g. '261.63,329.63,392'.

inputs.name: notes
inputs.description: Chord partials as comma-separated note names, e.g. 'C4,E4,G4'. Overrides frequencies.

inputs.name: waveform
inputs.description: Waveform for tone/chord: sine | square | triangle | sawtooth. (sweep is sine.)

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Noise color: white | pink | brown | blue | violet | velvet.

inputs.name: freq_start
inputs.description: Sweep start frequency in Hz.

inputs.name: freq_end
inputs.description: Sweep end frequency in Hz.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Noise RNG seed (fixed -> reproducible output).

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Duration in seconds (0 < d <= 3600).

inputs.name: sample_rate
inputs.description: Output sample rate in Hz (8000..192000).

inputs.name: channels
inputs.description: Output channels: 1 (mono) or 2 (duplicated stereo).

inputs.name: amplitude
inputs.description: Peak amplitude 0..1 (chords divide it across partials to avoid clipping).

inputs.name: fade_in_ms
inputs.description: Fade-in length in ms (afade; kills onset clicks).

inputs.name: fade_out_ms
inputs.description: Fade-out length in ms (afade).

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output format/container: wav | mp3 | flac | opus | ogg | m4a.

inputs.name: sample_fmt
inputs.description: PCM sample format for wav only: s16 | s24 | s32 | flt.

inputs.name: bitrate
inputs.description: Audio bitrate for lossy formats (mp3/opus/ogg/m4a), e.g. 192k. Per-format default when omitted.

inputs.name: ffmpeg_path
inputs.description: Explicit ffmpeg.exe path override (else resolved from PATH / known locations).

inputs.name: ffprobe_path
inputs.description: Explicit ffprobe.exe path override (else the sibling of the resolved ffmpeg).
